card.name: Capital M starting initials or acronyms
card.fires_on: The capital letter M (or MA) standing alone as the start of an author initial in reference lists, or the start of an acronym like MAOI or MTL.

modes.label: Author initial M
modes.description: The initial M for a first name in a citation author list, usually followed by a period and surname.
modes.example: paper in Climate Dynamics, by Grinsted and 3 of the same authors plus M. Macias Fauria, S. Helama,<< M>>. Timonen, and M. E

modes.label: Acronym start MA/M
modes.description: The opening letters of an acronym such as MAOI or MTL, before the rest of the letters.
modes.example: The concomitant use of fluoxetine with<< MA>>OIs is contraindicated.
